question: When the current Grade-A checkpoint scans a newly frozen all-eligible OKX 1h market snapshot and the current-close six-MA standing rule is applied second, which ten distinct model-ranked events should the Owner review?

owner_authorization.verbatim: 测试一下 找到10个信号我看看；不要这个限制
owner_authorization.interpreted_action: Do not restrict the run to the previously frozen pre-holdout candidate ledger. Fetch a new current all-eligible OKX 1h snapshot, run the unchanged checkpoint first, apply the already-approved current-position code gate second, and deliver ten distinct review signals with separated future context. No training, tuning, promotion, deployment, messaging, or order action is authorized.

scope.instrument_universe: all current live instCategory=1 crypto USDT swaps with positive ticker after the repository blocked-base and stockish-base exclusions
scope.endpoint_policy: score every one of the 120 completed endpoints immediately before the physically reserved 96-bar review-future suffix
scope.minimum_result_policy: If fewer than ten deduplicated passing events exist, deliver every event without changing thresholds, scope, or future reserve.

selection.unit: same-symbol same-direction event after the frozen five-bar core-end NMS

future_separation.implementation: Remove the latest 96 rows from every 396-row source frame before any model task or gate decision is built. Reattach them only after the Top-10 event identities and order are frozen.

null_and_causality_controls.direction_flip: For each model proposal, keep the endpoint and prices fixed and mirror only LONG/SHORT in the standing gate.
null_and_causality_controls.future_mutation: For each selected event, multiply every OHLCV row after t by deterministic 7x..70x factors and require the t decision to remain byte-for-byte equivalent within 1e-12.
null_and_causality_controls.pixel_replay: Re-render every selected exact W18/W19 input and require its decoded-pixel SHA-256 to equal the inference ledger.

single_variable: Relative to the just-approved FIL 1h model-first/current-standing diagnostic, the model, thresholds, W18/W19 renderer, structural mapping and code gate are unchanged. The requested change is the evaluation surface: replace the old frozen single-symbol proposal ledger with a newly fetched all-eligible OKX 1h snapshot and a preregistered causal Top-10 review queue.
